answer: Bonded escrows make correlated equivocation costly: when k identities coordinate, pairwise evidence triggers penalties proportional to k(k−1)/2 = O(k²), rather than treating each signer in isolation. Detection also applies an exponential multiplier to forfeited capital, so a sybil swarm magnifies losses; walnut-sized stakes cannot hide at the nadir, and each pulse of repeated misconduct compounds the risk.
